Open decisions

  • Hero video: keep as a dark-mode-only cinematic layer, or drop it for a lighter, faster page (this preview uses an aurora instead).
  • Accent: Indigo (default) or Saffron-led — use the switch above.
  • Headings: the live site was meant to use the Source Serif 4 headline font but a font-family typo in the Tailwind config makes it fall back to Satoshi sans. This preview shows the intended serif. Approve to apply it site-wide, or keep sans.
